name: Appartement Geisshornblick
beschreibung: Appartement Geisshornblick in Tannheim blends the warm atmosphere of a traditional alpine inn with the independence of holiday apartments. The property's name reflects its picturesque location with panoramic views of the prominent Geisshorn peak. The apartments are equipped with kitchens, making them ideal for self-catering. Regional dishes are served in the inn's own restaurant. Located at the entrance to the Tannheimer Tal, the property serves as a prime starting point for hiking tours and ski touring. The Tannheim ski area is within easy walking distance.
